name: anime-break
description: Watch anime in a pane while the model works: ani-cli finds the episode, mpv draws it as terminal cells, plays during each turn and pauses when the turn ends

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Width of the picture in terminal cells

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Height of the picture in terminal rows (two pixels each)

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How often the picture is redrawn

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: The stream ani-cli picks: worst, best or a height such as 480

mode.title: Drawing
mode.description: Coloured half blocks, ASCII, or ASCII in colour

place.title: Where
place.description: window: above the prompt, as tall as the picture; pane: the side pane
